purpose: Find a strictly $0 lawful and fresh current-season RPL fixture source; identify provider terms whose meaning requires written confirmation.

contradiction.preciseConflict: API-specific 2026-04-23 terms §1/§5 explicitly permit attributed early-stage commercial derived analytics, while general site 2026-04-12 §2.2, §2.8–2.10 prohibit commercial site use and substantial database extraction or automated requests. Scope and priority of `/api/widget/` vs website terms unclear; do not assume approval.

sportscore.endpointAccessInThisStudy: No authenticated provider integration. The documented public GET URL was not successfully fetched with the available read-only research browser. No assumption of coverage or actual quota consumption.

freeHistoricalAccessReview.analysis: Free interface documents live/recent matches and bounded team recent/upcoming data; no published season selector nor multi-season pagination. Vendor terms list historical access beyond public API among paid-tier uses. Do not assume free extraction of both completed 240-match seasons even if vendor permits attributed applications. Free limited recent results may still suit prospective fixtures after rights, coverage and freshness are checked. A separate, newly confirmed public REST v1 reference documents day-scoped fixtures/search endpoints; the earlier eight-endpoint count refers to WIDGET endpoints only and must not be read as a complete API inventory. Original match rights and season-wide bulk reuse remain unresolved.

publicV1Discovery.supportedDayScope: one UTC YYYY-MM-DD calendar day with optional competition/team/status
publicV1Discovery.conclusion: The previously counted eight widget endpoints are NOT the complete documented API. Separate anonymous REST v1 fixtures/search paths exist, and could help bounded current-season discovery if coverage and provider rights are verified. A day-scoped fixture lookup is not an approved complete historic-season bulk extraction plan.

uefa.upstreamGroup: RPL/RFU-derived; UEFA is an international federation listing domestic competition, not the domestic organizer's original match protocol
uefa.termsReading: UEFA general website §6.2 limits use to personal platform viewing and explicitly prohibits systematic collection/compilation of content to create a database, collection or directory. This domestic league page has no documented open data license or automated extraction permission.

limitations: A website openly displays a calendar does not mean it is legal to systematically compile it. Different terms for the SportScore /api/widget/ product and general website could have different scope, but FootballForecast has no authoritatively documented precedence. Do not solve the dispute by picking the more favorable paragraph. No real RPL API feed was authenticated in this research, no match rows stored, no ingestion or ML enabled. Documented SportScore public GET reference enumerates 8 widget endpoints with no season selector/pagination; terms list historical depth beyond public API as a paid-tier use case, so the minimum two completed seasons are NOT obtainable via any VERIFIED free endpoint. Never pay, upgrade, infer season coverage or synthesize 240 games.
